summary: Chicago Atlantic Real Estate Finance filed an 8-K on June 17, 2026, regarding a merger agreement with Chicago Atlantic BDC, Inc. The registrant's board approved a plan where the company will elect to become a BDC before merging into the acquiror, with the surviving company continuing as a RIC. No deal terms—price, premium, or stake—were disclosed. The special committee of independent directors recommended the transaction. The filing primarily signals a change in corporate structure and management advisory agreements, not a typical acquisition with economic terms. What to watch: stockholder approval for the BDC election and merger mechanics.
